title: Early tenor influences: Joe Thomas above all
summary: Cobb names Hawkins, Byas, Ben Webster and Joe Thomas as influences, saying Joe Thomas mattered most.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Well, now by this time, then, who had you heard on tenor? I mean who were your early influences -- who influenced you originally?

I had a lot of people to influence me that I lived to listen to at that time. I had Coleman Hawkins, I had Don Byas, I had Ben Webster with Duke, I had Joe Thomas with Luntford. Now, out of all of those -- I loved them all, but you know who I was influenced by more than all of them? Joe Thomas.
I don't think you heard me say that...
